The import path preserves the dashboard JSON and posts it to `/api/dashboards/import`; formatting is more likely lost when panels are instantiated, migrated, or normalized by plugin defaults. Table widths/alignment and thresholds are stored in `panel.fieldConfig`, while plugin-specific settings are stored in `panel.options`.
